android.desc:
HFG ENTERTAINMENTS proudly Presents Endless Escape Games Challenge  of various themes?  As the genres vary, the corresponding locations also vary accordingly to meet the demands and expectations of the players. All the games in this 252 levels are the best mini-puzzle escape games that will definitely test your brainteaser memory power.

Experience a mystery escape game that truly stands out from the rest.
Join millions of players who have already enjoyed this all-time popular brain challenge.

Sharpen your IQ with mind-bending puzzles, thrilling missions, and tricky riddles as you progress through an adventurous escape journey.

Searching for a real escape room challenge? This game brings the experience right to your device.

Do you have the skills to escape all 252 rooms?
Test your intelligence, memory, and observation with this fun and addictive brain-teaser adventure.

FEATURES: 	
*Challenging 252 Games Waiting for you
*Suitable for all gender age groups
*Picturesque Locations. 
*Riddling Puzzles.
*Addictive Gameplay (75 hours).
*Polished animation.
*Realistic graphics.

Available in 25 languages---- (English, Arabic, Chinese Simplified, Chinese Traditional, Czech, Danish, Dutch, French, German, Greek, Hindi, Hungarian, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Malay, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Swedish, Thai, Turkish, Vietnamese)
